senses.gloss: f. (<cite ref="K00941"><he>כסל</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00941"><he>כֶּסֶל</he></cite>; cmp. P. Sm. s. v. 1786, sq.)

units: <cite ref="Taanit 21b:15">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>לבושא דיתיב ביה קרנא והוה בזיעא בי כ׳</he> (v. Var. in Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a garment in which there was placed (fastened) a cup (for receiving the blood) which (garment) was cut in at the shoulder (so that the operator could let blood standing behind the female patient); [Ar. <he>לבושא דאית ליה ביזעי ביזעי באפי כ׳</he> a garment in which there were several incisions to correspond to the shoulder-blade.]

senses.gloss: the lancet for blood-letting. ריבדא דכ׳ the puncture made by the lancet.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 129a:16">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דנפיק מר׳ דכ׳</he> until the puncture was healed up.
<cite ref="Ketubot 39b:3">Keth. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>כי ר׳ דכ׳</he> as much pain as is caused by the puncture of the lancet.
<cite ref="Niddah 67a:6">Nidd. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>הני רבדי דכ׳</he> the marks of the punctures &c.
